भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) लू की चेतावनी प्रणाली को अधिक सटीक बनाने के लिए जनता और विशेषज्ञों से ऑनलाइन सर्वेक्षण के माध्यम से प्रतिक्रिया ले रहा है।

जनता और विशेषज्ञों से ऑनलाइन प्रतिक्रिया मांगी जा रही है
उद्देश्य अलर्ट को अधिक सटीक और जन-उपयोगी बनाना है
संजीव गुप्ता, नई दिल्ली। भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) अपने मौसम पूर्वानुमानों और चेतावनी (अलर्ट) की सटीकता को जमीनी हकीकत के और करीब लाने के लिए अब आम जनता और विशेषज्ञों से सीधे फीडबैक ले रहा है।
इसके निमित्त विभाग विशेष आनलाइन सर्वेक्षण कर रहा है। इस सर्वेखण के जरिए लू से जुड़े अलर्ट और उनके प्रभावों पर प्रतिक्रिया मांगी जा रही है।
क्या है मौसम विभाग की योजना
IMD की मंशा सिर्फ तापमान का आंकड़ा जारी करने तक सीमित रहने की नहीं है, बल्कि वह समझना चाहता है कि उसके द्वारा जारी किए गए ''येलो'', ''आरेंज'' और ''रेड'' अलर्ट का असर जमीन पर कितना सटीक बैठता है। इस सर्वे का मुख्य उद्देश्य चेतावनी प्रणाली को और अधिक व्यावहारिक, सटीक एवं जन-उपयोगी बनाना है।
विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि जलवायु परिवर्तन के कारण मौसम के मिजाज में आ रहे तेजी से बदलावों के बीच केवल सैटेलाइट और रडार डेटा ही काफी नहीं हैं।
''ग्राउंड-लेवल फीडबैक'' से अर्ली वार्निंग सिस्टम को और अधिक विश्वसनीय बनाया जा सकेगा, जिससे शासन और आम लोग लू के खतरे से निपटने के लिए समय रहते बेहतर तैयारी कर सकें।
सर्वे के मुख्य बिंदु
- सटीकता का आकलन : मौसम विभाग जानना चाह रहा है कि लू को लेकर जारी पूर्वानुमान वास्तविक परिस्थितियों से कितने मेल खाते हैं।
- प्रभाव आधारित पूर्वानुमान : तापमान के साथ-साथ आम जनजीवन, स्वास्थ्य और दैनिक गतिविधियों पर पड़ने वाले असर को अलर्ट में बेहतर तरीके से कैसे शामिल किया जाए।
- सुझाव और सुधार : आम नागरिकों, स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञों व स्थानीय प्रशासनों से अलर्ट का दायरा और समय तय करने के संबंध में राय मांगी गई है।
आम लोगों और जमीनी फीडबैक से क्या सुधार आएगा
- सटीक प्रभाव-आधारित पूर्वानुमान : सैटेलाइट और रडार केवल तापमान और हवा की गति जैसे आंकड़े बताते हैं, जबकि जमीनी फीडबैक बताता है कि उस तापमान का इंसानी शरीर एवं स्थानीय जीवन पर वास्तव में क्या असर पड़ रहा है।
- माइक्रो-क्लाइमेट और स्थानीय इनपुट : शहरों में ''हीट आइलैंड'' (घनी आबादी या कंक्रीट के कारण अत्यधिक गर्मी) जैसे छोटे-छोटे क्षेत्रों की सटीक जानकारी केवल वहां रहने वाले लोगों और स्थानीय प्रशासन के अनुभव से मिलती है।
- अलर्ट की शब्दावली और भाषा में सुधार : आम जनता की राय से यह समझने में मदद मिलती है कि ''येलो'', ''आरेंज'' या ''रेड'' अलर्ट की भाषा लोगों को आसानी से समझ आ रही है या नहीं, ताकि चेतावनी मिलते ही लोग सही सुरक्षात्मक कदम उठा सकें।

Zaria beat Wren Sinclair and Kali Armstrong for NXT North American Championship and WWE Women’s Speed Championship
The first match on the show was a triple threat match for the unified titles in the women’s division. It was Zaria who was taking on the Speed Champion Wren Sinclair and Kali Armstrong. This was a 12 minute match where all 3 women got the opportunity to shine. Zaria and Kali Armstrong were initially ignoring Wren Sinclair but Wren Sinclair came back in the match. These three women were hitting each other with Suplexes and Kali Armstrong eventually took control of the match. There was a great spot where Wren Sinclair Superplexed Zaria. To end the match, Zaria hit the F5 on Kali Armstrong to become the unified champion.
The Vanity Project beat Myles Bourne and Tavion Heights for NXT Tag Team Championship
This was the second title change of the night. This tag team match was 14 minutes of non stop action. Myles Bourne was injured on the ribs and The Vanity Project kept attacking his ribs and prevented him from tagging Tavion Heights. Tavion Heights got the hot tag and he started giving Suplexes to both men and he applied the ankle lock. Myles Bourne hit two Powerslams and then followed it up with a Neckbreaker and DDT combo. A momentary lapse in focus and The Vanity Project won the match and became new NXT Tag Team Champions.
Kelani Jordan beat Kendal Grey for NXT Women’s Championship
Women’s wrestling was the winner on 30th August 2026. There were 2 Matches throughout the night at All In and Heatwave that went 23 minutes each. This one between Kendal Grey vs Kelani Jordan was the best match of NXT Heatwave. Kelani Jordan started the match hitting an Asai MoonSault which was not enough. Kelani Jordan started attacking the injured ear of Kendal Grey and it was a test for the champion. Both these women were locked in as Kendal Grey hit Overhead and German Suplexes and Kelani Jordan hit a Northern Lights Suplex. The fans were chanting This is Awesome. Kelani Jordan jumped over Kendal Grey and smashed the announce table. Kendal Grey hit a Reverse Spanish Fly and Kelani Jordan answered it with a twisting springboard cutter. Both women hit 450 Splashes, German Suplexes. Kelani Jordan won the title by hitting her MoonSault finisher. This was professional wrestling at its very best.
Jackson Drake beat Myles Bourne for NXT North American Championship
This was the shortest match of the night and it was understandable. Myles Bourne had already competed in a match. This was a 10 minute match. Myles Bourne fought with all his heart as he brought Jackson Drake down. Jackson Drake countered it with a series of kicks to the rib section. Tavion Heights came out to even the odds but The Vanity Project proved too much. Jackson Drake hit the 450 Splash to win the NXT North American Championship. This was a surprising title change. After the match Myles Bourne turned heel in a shocking outcome.
Grayson Waller beat Zilla Fatu, Cruz Montana and Tony D Angelo for NXT Championship
This was a 21 minute barn burner for the NXT Championship. There were 4 men who were looking to be the top dog in NXT. Zilla Fatu showed his power as he started giving Samoan Drops to all his opponents. Tony D Angelo gave a Spinebuster to Zilla Fatu. Cruz Montana delivered a Suicide Dive to the outside on all 3 of his opponents. Zilla Fatu hit the Samoan Spike on the champion and nearly won but Grayson Waller stopped the referee from counting. Grayson Waller delivered an elbow drop to Zilla Fatu on top of the announce table. Cruz Montana hit Tony D Angelo with his finisher but Grayson Waller appeared and stole the win and became the new NXT Champion. Grayson Waller has earned this title. There were 5 title Changes in one night.

Heavy rain likely in parts of Punjab, Haryana till Sept 5; IMD issues yellow alert
Fairly widespread rainfall forecast from Sept 3 to 5 as August monsoon remains below normal in both states
Amid below-normal monsoon rainfall over the region, the weather department has predicted heavy rain in a few parts of Punjab and Haryana from September 1 to 5, for which a yellow alert has been issued.
After about a week of relatively low monsoon activity, fairly widespread rainfall is also expected over Punjab and Haryana from September 3 to 5, according to a bulletin issued by the India Meteorological Department (IMD) on August 31.
The north-eastern and south-eastern parts of Punjab and the eastern belt of Haryana are likely to receive more rain than other areas of the two states during the week.
The IMD described the monsoon activity over Punjab and Haryana as “weak” during the past 24 hours, with light to moderate rain occurring at some places and heavy rain reported at isolated locations. Day and night temperatures in both states also remained above normal.
In Punjab, monsoon rainfall during August remained 35 per cent below the long-period average (LPA). From August 1 till the morning of August 31, the state received 94.5 mm of rain against the LPA of 146.2 mm for the period.
Monthly rainfall remained below the LPA in all districts of Punjab except Gurdaspur, where it was 24 per cent above normal. The deficiency ranged up to 84 per cent, with Tarn Taran, Kapurthala, Mohali and Jalandhar among the worst-affected districts.
In Haryana, monsoon rainfall during the month was six per cent below the LPA, with the state receiving 138.8 mm of rain against the LPA of 147.7 mm. Rainfall was below the LPA in 11 districts, with Karnal, Jind and Kaithal being the worst affected.
According to the IMD, a western disturbance persists over north Pakistan and the adjoining Jammu region at 5.8 km above mean sea level. The monsoon trough, a key rain-bearing weather feature, currently passes through Amritsar, Patiala and Najibabad.
Under the influence of these systems, the IMD has also predicted fairly widespread to widespread rainfall over Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh till September 2, and over Himachal Pradesh till September 4. Isolated to scattered rainfall is expected over these areas thereafter till September 6.
